label: Ultimatum
detail: Deadline to reopen Hormuz by 8 p.m. ET or face strikes on power plants and bridges ("a whole civilization will die tonight"), after extensions since Mar 21. Instead Trump announced a two-week pause in bombing, brokered by Pakistan.

label: Project Freedom
detail: Navy escort operation launched May 4 with destroyers, 100+ aircraft and 15,000 personnel to bring ships out of the Gulf. Paused May 5–6, citing "great progress" toward a deal.

label: Strike off
detail: Trump called off "a very major attack" planned for May 19 at the request of Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the UAE, putting it off "hopefully, maybe forever."

label: Oman threat
detail: At a May 27 cabinet meeting Trump said Oman would "behave just like everybody else or we'll have to blow them up" over Iran-Oman toll sharing. No action followed.

label: Kharg threat
detail: Trump posted that the US would hit Iran "VERY HARD TONIGHT" and take Kharg Island. Hours later he said Kharg was off the table and a deal was close.

label: MOU signed
detail: Instead of escalating, Trump signed the 14-point MOU at a Versailles dinner after the G7; Pezeshkian also signed. The blockade was lifted the next day.

label: Stand-down
detail: After strikes over a drone hit on a cargo ship, Trump warned Iran "will no longer exist" if forced to "complete the job," then stood down.

label: Strikes
detail: The truce collapsed after Iran allegedly hit commercial ships. About 11 nights of US strikes on 300+ targets followed; the oil waiver was revoked and the blockade reinstated Jul 14. The only threat carried out.

label: Troops killed
detail: Two US soldiers (Lt. Tyler Freehan, Pvt. Isabella Gonzales) were killed and one went missing in Iranian attacks in Jordan. Trump said Iran "will pay ... many times over," but there was no escalation beyond the ongoing strikes.

label: Bank deadline
detail: Billed as "economic D-Day," the six-month sanctions deadline brought only narrow steps against Egypt's Banque Misr branches in the UAE; the toughest bank sanctions were held back.

label: Blink #10?
detail: At the UN, Trump said "deal or annihilate" and a deal would come "right after the election." It counts as a blink if a deal meets none of Rubio's three terms, or if Dec 31 passes with neither.
